name: Hungary
deceptionLabel: The Hidden 18.5% Employee SSC + 13% Employer Contribution
note: Advertised as a simple 15% flat tax — but total labour cost is 46.5% above net pay

layers.label: Personal Income Tax (Flat 15%)
layers.note: No brackets, no basic exemption for general adult workers

layers.label: Employee Social Security Contribution (non-deductible !!!)
layers.note: On payslip but rarely mentioned in 'flat 15% tax' headlines — employee keeps only 66.5% of gross!

layers.label: Employer Social Contribution Tax (!!!)
layers.note: 13% on top of gross salary, very high contribution cap (24 times the monthly minimum wage of 6,979,200 HUF)
